feature.name: Equation
feature.what_it_does: Author a mathematical equation in the selected math zone — conversions, symbols and structures (fractions, scripts, radicals, integrals, matrices…).
feature.affects: the content of the selected equation
feature.behavior: Author a mathematical equation in the selected math zone — conversions, symbols and structures (fractions, scripts, radicals, integrals, matrices…).

connections.why: measured: the hosting contextual tab appears only in this object's context

subfeatures.name: Conversions
subfeatures.what_it_does: Converts the equation's notation between professional/linear, Unicode, LaTeX and text (Convert menu + Equation Options).
subfeatures.behavior: Running it changes the selection's formatting (the equation's notation format). Measured toggle: a second press from the same state reverts the change (on/off behavior).

behavior_record.effect: Running it changes the selection's formatting (the equation's notation format). Measured toggle: a second press from the same state reverts the change (on/off behavior).
behavior_record.defaults: baseline: the command applied its effect from the staged neutral state (measured delta above); pre-selected options not separately diffed
behavior_record.state_rules: enabled in context(s): equation; disabled in: header-edit (measured via GetEnabledMso) — the disabled contexts are its preconditions; no pressed state observed (a command, not a toggle)

subfeatures.name: Ink Equation
subfeatures.what_it_does: Opens a canvas to hand-write a math equation that is recognized into typeset math.

subfeatures.name: Structures
subfeatures.what_it_does: Inserts a math structure template into the equation — fraction, script, radical, integral, large operator, bracket, function, accent, limit/log, operator, or matrix (a palette of templates).
subfeatures.behavior: Opens the Fraction dropdown — the surface that presents this capability's options (11 controls enumerated in the structural pass). Applying a choice there changes: the equation content (adds a structure).

behavior_record.effect: Opens the Fraction dropdown — the surface that presents this capability's options (11 controls enumerated in the structural pass). Applying a choice there changes: the equation content (adds a structure).
